brief.ask: Art-direct "Cathedral Clerestory Sunbeams" — #3 of the 72 Ambo church visualizers (Calm Contemporary Worship lyric visualizer, Collection I of 72; subgenre Sacred Architecture). Premise: Gothic vaulted arcade and five lancet windows casting morning incense shafts. Soaring Gothic stone vaulting and five leaded lancet clerestory windows cast warm 4300K volumetric sunbeams through frankincense haze onto dark limestone. Lighting today: Key: High side clerestory windows at 4300K; warm floor bounce. Service use: Opening hymn, invocation, Eucharist, traditional & modern liturgy. Audio mapping today: Swell → Intensifies the volumetric sunbeam shafts from the 5 lancets; Shimmer → Illuminates floating frankincense dust motes; Vocal → Warms the Gothic stone vault ribs and lancet tracery. Palette: #0A0E17 #1F2633 #D99B52 #FFF4DE. Keep the id, name, premise and palette; rebuild the direction: the geometry and depth planes, typography for the worship lyric band (one line at a time, four to five seconds a line, word-by-word progression), image logic (how the Gemini concept plate it twins (/sanctuary-plates/optical-light-leak-prism-overlay.jpg, blended in at plateBlend) and the procedural scene meet), texture, motion, and which audio channel drives what. Decide it — the lead's lens will drive the kit's material weave and optical pass for this one.
brief.audience: Congregations watching a projector or LED wall from the pews, five to forty metres away, eyes on the words; and the worship leader or volunteer running Ambo live from a laptop.
brief.feeling: Stillness and reverence — a sanctuary that breathes with the singer's voice; gorgeous, slow, never a screensaver.
constraints: Build method (fixed): a real-time Canvas 2D audio-reactive renderer in Plajah's worship visualizer kit — sanctuary background, multi-plane depth (god rays, motes, bokeh), the kit's Council optical pass (35mm light leaks, anamorphic flare, film grain, colour punch, and a tactile material weave keyed to the LEAD director's lens) and the kit's lyric / scripture typography engine. No video playback, no WebGL, no assets beyond the one concept plate.

Audio drives amplitude, colour, light, growth and glow only — never the position of the words. Envelopes are smoothed; nothing strobes or flashes (photosensitive-safe); uptempo pulses are spring-damped.

The reading band is sacred: lyrics or scripture must stay legible at 1920×1080 and 4K from the back pew, over the busiest moment of the scene. A text-safe dimming band is part of the kit; direct how the scene yields to it.

Typefaces are fixed to the kit's open-licensed set: Noto Serif (text serif), Outfit / Inter (sans), Cinzel (display), JetBrains Mono. Direct scale, case, tracking, measure and hierarchy, not new families.

Sacred imagery is used correctly and respectfully: biblical places and objects are specific and attributable, never costume; nothing denominational or branded; nothing that reads as a music video or a screensaver.
Runs at 60 fps on an integrated-GPU laptop driving a projector: favour layered gradients, cached textures and a few large shapes over particle storms.
Keep this visualizer's id, name, premise and four-colour palette. The council owns the direction, not the catalogue entry.
references: Concept plate: /sanctuary-plates/optical-light-leak-prism-overlay.jpg — a Gemini art plate this visualizer was built as the interactive code twin of.
Sample lyric lines on the band: "Be still my soul the Lord is on thy side" / "Bear patiently the cross of grief or pain".

proposals.title: Five Voices, One Stone
proposals.idea: The five lancet windows are the cantus firmus — each a fixed vertical measure governing every light shaft, mote field, and lyric interval so that the scene is not decorated but constituted by proportion.
proposals.geometry: A 1920×1080 canvas divided by five equal vertical bays derived from the lancet spacing — each bay 384px wide at 1080p, 512px at 4K. These bay axes are declared as code constants before any draw call. God-ray shafts originate precisely on each axis at the top edge; their base splays no wider than 0.618 of the bay width (the golden section used structurally, not decoratively). The vaulted ceiling is rendered as a symmetric pointed-arch grid: two primary ribs rise from the outer bay axes to a crown keystone centred at canvas-top; secondary tiercerons branch at 60° from rib midpoints. A horizontal string-course sits at 38.2% of canvas height — the text-safe floor. Everything below that line is the lyric zone; everything above is the architectural field. Nothing crosses the string-course without earning it: the only element permitted to bridge is the lowest hem of a god-ray, and only when the
proposals.typography: Cinzel, capitals only, for the lyric line — set at 3.2vw (≈61px at 1080p) with letter-spacing 0.18em; this tracking is the typographic equivalent of the lancet's slender proportion. Noto Serif italic at 1.4vw carries the scripture attribution one line below, flush to the same left bay-axis as the primary lyric, creating a two-voice hierarchy. The lyric band sits centred horizontally across all five bays; vertical position is fixed at 72% of canvas height — inside the text-safe zone, resting on the implied string-course. Word-by-word progression: each incoming word fades from 0 to full opacity over 180ms, no movement, no slide — appearance only, because the words are not performing, they are arriving. The completed line holds for the duration of the line (four to five seconds); on release it fades in 320ms. No line ever moves position mid-display. Measure: no lyric line exceeds 60% of can
proposals.imageLogic: The concept plate /sanctuary-plates/optical-light-leak-prism-overlay.jpg is composited as the sole photographic authority for chromatic aberration and prismatic edge colour. It enters at plateBlend (operator: screen, opacity 0.18 at rest) stretched to full canvas — it is not a background image but an optical filter riding above the procedural scene, below the lyric band. The plate's warm leak zones (amber, pale gold) register over the shaft axes; its cooler prism fringing falls in the inter-bay columns of stone — this is not accidental, it is selected by pre-sampling the plate at each bay axis and using those sampled luminance values as the per-shaft intensity seed. When the swell channel rises, plateBlend climbs from 0.18 to 0.32; when it falls, it returns on a 1.4s ease-out — the plate breathes with the organ, never strobing. The plate contributes no geometry; all structural lines come
proposals.texture: Limestone texture is synthesised procedurally: a base gradient from #0A0E17 to #1F2633 is overlaid with a noise field (octave 4, persistence 0.45, frequency 0.008) rendered once to an offscreen canvas and cached — never redrawn per frame. This gives the walls a slow, cool granularity without particle cost. The vault ribs are drawn as filled bezier paths 6px wide at 1080p, anti-aliased, with a 1px inner highlight at #D99B52 opacity 0.3 — simulating the dressed-stone edge that catches raking light. Film grain is a pre-baked 512×512 luminance noise texture tiled over the full canvas at 3% opacity, updated every 4 frames (15fps grain on a 60fps scene) — the temporal mismatch is the human trace of analogue capture. The frankincense haze is a single large elliptical radial gradient per shaft, not particles: warm centre #D99B52 at 6% opacity, transparent at edge, 180px wide, 600px tall. It move
proposals.motion: Entry sequence obeys temporal hierarchy — the measure is stated before the content exists. At t=0ms the vault silhouette fades in over 600ms (#0A0E17 to #1F2633 gradient, no shaft). At t=600ms the five haze ellipses appear simultaneously at 0% opacity and rise to their rest opacity (6%) over 800ms — the architectural light before any audio. At t=1400ms the scene is complete and audio-reactive motion begins. Swell (organ): shaft haze opacity scales linearly from 6% to 18% as amplitude rises from 0 to 1.0; vertical haze drift engages above 0.4 amplitude; plateBlend rises proportionally. All swell responses are smoothed through a 120ms exponential envelope — no strobe. Shimmer (high strings/cymbal): mote layer — five clusters of 12 ellipses each (60 total, not a particle storm), each cluster centred on a lancet axis, each mote a 3×3px ellipse at #FFF4DE, opacity driven by shimmer amplitude
proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D renderer, 60fps. Offscreen canvases: one for the limestone noise texture (rendered once, 1920×1080, reused every frame), one for the grain tile (512×512, redrawn every 4 frames). Main frame draw order: (1) limestone gradient + noise composite, (2) vault rib bezier paths with inner highlight, (3) five haze ellipses (radial gradients), (4) concept plate blended screen at dynamic plateBlend, (5) mote layer (60 small ellipses, positions pre-computed, opacity only varies), (6) grain tile overlay, (7) text-safe dimming band, (8) lyric/scripture typography. Audio analysis: Web Audio API AnalyserNode, three bandpass regions mapped to swell/shimmer/vocal; all amplitude values passed through exponential smoothing (α=0.15 per frame). All structural constants — bay width, shaft axis x-positions, string-course y, rib crown y, plateBlend rest/peak, envelope durations — are exported as a sing
proposals.humanTrace: The grain tile updated at 15fps against a 60fps scene: the temporal mismatch is the trace of analogue film. The concept plate's chromatic fringing — photographed or generated physical light through glass — is the trace of a real optical event, not a procedural approximation. The vault rib bezier paths are drawn with a 0.5px positional jitter seeded once at load time (not per frame), so no two instances of this visualizer produce geometrically identical ribs — the jitter is the trace of a mason's hand on dressed stone, fixed at construction, never moving again.
proposals.risk: The restraint is the risk. Five haze gradients and sixty small ellipses instead of a particle storm will read as austere to anyone who expects contemporary worship visuals to fill every pixel with motion. The Baroque Dramatist will say the reveal is too quiet. I say a cathedral does not announce its light — it allows it. If the congregation is watching the shafts instead of the words, this direction has failed; if they are reading the words inside a room that breathes, it has resolved.

arguesWith.why: The Baroque Dramatist will want the god-rays to swell dramatically into the lyric zone, to let the shaft geometry break the string-course and engulf the text in light at the Eucharist's peak moment. I refuse: the string-course is structural, not decorative, and a text that drowns in its own atmosphere is a text that cannot be read. The revelation in a Gothic clerestory is not the shaft of light —

proposals.title: Stone That Breathes Ink
proposals.idea: The concept plate is not ambience — it is a registration mark: every shaft angle, mote drift, and vault-rib warm are answerable to the prism geometry baked into optical-light-leak-prism-overlay.jpg before the first audio sample lands.
proposals.geometry: Five lancet windows are not decorative arches — they are the five vertical pressure zones that divide the canvas into fifths. Each fifth owns one god-ray column, one mote drift lane, and one vertical slice of the lyric-safe floor band. The vaulting ribs are generated as a fan of eight converging lines from a single vanishing point at 62% height, 50% horizontal — not centred, pulled slightly right so the eye reads movement toward light. The lyric band sits in the lower 22% of frame, its top edge defined by where the floor-bounce gradient crosses 18% luminance — the scene itself sets the shelf. No decorative border. The text-safe dimming band is a genuine darkening of the stone floor plane, not a box floated over the image.
proposals.typography: Cinzel, tracked +180, all caps, 4.2vw at 1080p — large enough to read from 40 metres, narrow enough that five lancet shafts of light can breathe beside it. Lyric lines enter word by word, each word fading up in 120ms, previous word holding at 70% opacity so the phrase accumulates without vanishing. No slide, no bounce — opacity only, because stone does not slide. Between lines, a 0.6-second silence: the band holds the last word at 40% before clearing. Scripture attribution in Outfit Regular, 1.4vw, tracked +60, sitting 8px below the lyric baseline — a different material, a different scale, not competing. Colour: #FFF4DE at rest; Vocal channel warms it toward #D99B52 at peak, transitioning over 400ms. No drop shadow. Legibility is carried by the dimming band, not by stroke or shadow.
proposals.imageLogic: optical-light-leak-prism-overlay.jpg is loaded at plateBlend opacity (default 0.28, range 0.18–0.38 driven by Swell RMS). It is not a background — it is a prior physical commitment. The plate's prism leak geometry is sampled at startup: the renderer extracts the dominant shaft angles from the plate's luminance distribution and uses those angles to seed the five procedural god-ray columns. If the plate says a shaft tilts 7° left, the Canvas 2D ray tilts 7°. The plate is blended in multiply mode below the procedural scene so its colour information stains the stone without overwhelming the generated light. The frankincense haze layer sits above the plate and below the god rays — it is a soft radial gradient at 4300K that the plate cannot override. The plate earns its place by constraining geometry; it does not earn it by being pretty.
proposals.texture: Simulated limestone grain: a cached 512×512 Perlin noise texture, monochrome, tiled across the lower two-thirds of the frame, blended in overlay at 12% — enough to feel porous, not enough to read as decoration. Frankincense haze: five Gaussian radial gradients, one per lancet column, #FFF4DE at 6% opacity, radius 18% of canvas width, drifting upward at 0.4px per frame — slow enough that it reads as incense smoke, fast enough that the scene is never frozen. Vault ribs: drawn as 3px Canvas 2D lines at #1F2633 with a 1px inner stroke at #D99B52 at 30% — the warm edge simulates raking light on stone without a 3D render. Film grain: a per-frame noise pass at 4% amplitude, computed in a small offscreen canvas and composited at the end of each draw cycle — this is the material witness, the thing that proves a frame was made.
proposals.motion: Order of movement, slow to fast: (1) Vault ribs are static — they are the skeleton, they do not breathe. (2) Haze columns drift upward continuously at 0.4px/frame regardless of audio — the incense does not care about the music. (3) God rays pulse on Swell: shaft luminance scales from 0.6 to 1.0 of peak brightness, envelope smoothed over 180ms, spring-damped with k=0.12 so no strobe. (4) Motes — maximum 40 particles per lane, 200 total — illuminate on Shimmer: their opacity scales 0.1 to 0.45, positions held, no new spawning on audio hit, only luminance change. Position drift is continuous at 0.2px/frame upward with a ±0.08px horizontal wander per frame. (5) Vault rib warm: Vocal channel drives a colour interpolation on the rib inner-stroke from #1F2633 toward #D99B52, over 400ms attack, 800ms release — the stone listens to the voice and answers slowly. (6) Lyric band: word-by-word opacit
proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D renderer, 60fps, single requestAnimationFrame loop. All textures are generated procedurally or loaded from the one permitted plate. Startup routine: load plate, sample shaft angles via offscreen canvas pixel read at 24 horizontal slices, store as shaftAngles[5]. Each frame: clear, draw stone gradient (#0A0E17 to #1F2633 top-to-bottom), tile Perlin overlay, draw plate at multiply blend, draw haze columns, draw god rays as Canvas 2D trapezoid fills (wide at top, narrow at floor) with globalAlpha keyed to Swell, draw motes as small ellipses with globalAlpha keyed to Shimmer, draw vault ribs as lineTo paths, run film grain pass on offscreen canvas and composite, draw lyric band dimming gradient, draw text. No WebGL. No video. No particle system beyond 200 cached ellipse objects. Plate angle sampling happens once at load; no per-frame pixel reads.
proposals.humanTrace: The shaft angles are not invented — they are read from the plate. A human made that plate with prism geometry that has its own bias, its own accident. The renderer is accountable to that accident. The film grain is recomputed every frame from a seeded random function, not looped — each frame has a different grain, the way each second of candlelight is different. The vault ribs are drawn by hand-specified lineTo coordinates, not auto-generated from a formula — someone decided where the ribs go. These are the decisions that a machine would not make the same way twice.
proposals.risk: The risk is that reading the plate at startup and locking shaft angles to its geometry will occasionally produce a god-ray column that fights the lancet window position — the plate was made with prism logic, not Gothic window logic, and those two systems may not agree. I take that risk because the disagreement between the plate and the scene is the truth of the method: the plate is a prior commitment, not a servant. A direction that always agrees with itself is decoration. The other risk is that 200 motes and tiled grain on integrated GPU will drop frames — mitigated by caching the grain pass at 25fps while the main loop runs at 60, acceptable because grain does not need to be frame-perfect.

arguesWith.why: The Baroque Dramatist will want the god rays to surge, the motes to swarm, the vault to glow with compounding warmth on every audio peak — drama stacked on drama. I say the scene earns reverence by withholding: the ribs do not pulse, the haze does not react, only the light intensifies and the stone warms on the voice. proposals.title: Five Lancets, One Rule
proposals.idea: A single generative axiom — five lancet window apertures at fixed anamorphic angles — derives every downstream parameter: beam geometry, mote field density, vault rib luminance, lyric safe-zone dimming, and all audio-reactive outputs, so the scene behaves as a coherent optical instrument rather than a decorated background.
proposals.geometry: Five lancet apertures are declared as coordinate authorities at x-positions [0.12, 0.28, 0.50, 0.72, 0.88] of canvas width, each with a fixed angle of 7° inward convergence toward a vanishing point at y=0.62 (below horizon, floor-bounce logic). Each aperture emits a beam trapezoid whose near-edge width is 3.2% canvas width and far-edge width is 9.6% canvas width — a 3× spread over the full depth plane. The five beams establish a vertical rhythm that governs every other element: vault rib positions are interpolated between beam centrelines at 0.5× spacing; bokeh mote spawn columns are licensed only within ±1.4× beam half-width at any given y-depth; the lyric band occupies a horizontal strip from y=0.74 to y=0.91, precisely below the beam convergence zone, where the five trapezoids have widened enough to create a diffuse wash rather than hard shafts — this is the structural reason the text
proposals.typography: Cinzel, uppercase, tracked at +0.18em, set at 3.2vw (scales to ~55px at 1080p, ~110px at 4K). Single lyric line per display cycle; word-by-word reveal via opacity ramp per word token, 280ms per word, held until line expires at 4–5s. Active word: #FFF4DE at full opacity. Preceding words: #FFF4DE at 0.55 opacity. Pending words: not yet visible. No fade-out between lines — hard cut masked by a 120ms luminance bloom on the incoming first word, which reads as a breath rather than an edit. The text-safe dimming band is a radial gradient rectangle from y=0.72 to y=0.93: base fill #0A0E17 at 0.72 opacity, Vocal-amplitude-driven to 0.58 minimum — the band never fully clears, it only breathes slightly more open when the voice swells. Letter-spacing tightens 0.02em on Vocal peak to simulate the perceptual narrowing of type under warm light — a computed response, not a style choice.
proposals.imageLogic: The concept plate /sanctuary-plates/optical-light-leak-prism-overlay.jpg is loaded once at init, drawn at canvas dimensions with globalCompositeOperation='screen', opacity=plateBlend (kit variable, default 0.18). It is not decorative overlay — it is read as a luminance sample authority on a 24×14 grid at startup. Each grid cell's L-channel value licenses the local beam intensity scalar for the nearest lancet beam at that x-column: cells with L>0.6 boost that beam's alpha ceiling by +0.12; cells with L<0.2 suppress mote spawn probability in that column by 40%. The plate is never re-sampled at runtime — it is a one-time constraint map baked into the beam and mote parameter tables. This means the plate's own optical geometry (its prism streaks and light leak topology) is embedded in the procedural scene as a coordinate rule, not as a visible texture. proposals.texture: Simulated limestone: a cached 512×512 noise texture generated at init via layered fBm (4 octaves, lacunarity 2.1, gain 0.48) in greyscale, drawn at 15% opacity beneath the floor gradient with multiply blend — gives the dark stone a pore-level granularity without a photo asset. Frankincense haze: a radial gradient fog layer at y=0.0 to y=0.5, #D99B52 at 0.04 opacity, updated each frame with a slow vertical drift (+0.04px/frame) that wraps — this is the haze medium the beams travel through, not an effect on top of them. Vault ribs: drawn as 2px bezier strokes in #1F2633 lightened by Vocal amplitude toward #D99B52 — stone that warms when sung to. No grain pass added separately; the fBm noise texture and mote field together carry the tactile register. The optical pass adds anamorphic flare streaks at beam centrelines using horizontal lens-blur simulation (a 1D convolution kernel cached at 64
proposals.motion: Everything moves on continuous low-frequency oscillators except the lyric band, which is clock-driven. Beam shafts: base alpha 0.28, Swell amplitude drives alpha ceiling to 0.72; alpha updates at 60fps through a lag filter (τ=1.8s) — no strobbing. Beam width breathes on a 7.3s sine (±4% of base width) independent of audio, simulating cloud-pass light variation. Motes: 120 particles maximum (GPU-safe), each assigned to a licensed column, drifting upward at 0.06–0.18px/frame with lateral Brownian ±0.03px/frame; Shimmer amplitude multiplies spawn rate by up to 2.2× and raises individual mote luminance from #D99B52 at 0.4 opacity to #FFF4DE at 0.85 opacity. Vault ribs: Vocal RMS drives a luminance lerp from #1F2633 to a rib-warm value (#8B6A3A) over τ=0.9s. Bokeh: 18 fixed large circles (r=28–64px) at positions pre-licensed by the plate luminance grid, blur-rendered via shadow trick, Swell-d
proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D renderer, 60fps rAF loop. Init phase: load concept plate → sample 24×14 luminance grid → write beam intensity scalars and mote column probabilities to typed arrays → generate fBm noise texture into offscreen canvas → cache anamorphic lens-blur kernel. Runtime loop: clear → draw floor gradient → draw fBm stone texture (multiply) → draw haze gradient → update and draw five beam trapezoids (additive) → update and draw bokeh circles (screen) → update and draw mote particles → composite optical pass (plate at screen blend, plateBlend opacity) → draw vault rib strokes → draw lyric band dimming rectangle → draw lyric text layer. Audio: Web Audio API AnalyserNode feeding three smoothed amplitude scalars (Swell=low-mid RMS, Shimmer=high-freq RMS, Vocal=mid-freq peak) through exponential lag filters before any parameter reads them. All parameters are derivable from the five lancet coordi
proposals.humanTrace: The fBm limestone texture is generated with seed values derived from the plate's own luminance grid checksum — so the stone's pore pattern is causally downstream of the concept plate's optical content. The beam angles (7° convergence) were computed from the architectural proportion of a real lancet window bay (approximate 1:4.5 width-to-height ratio common in English Decorated Gothic), not chosen aesthetically. The Vocal-driven rib luminance ramp uses a τ=0.9s envelope that approximates the decay tail of a sung vowel in a reverberant stone space — a physically-motivated timing, not a feel choice. The human trace is in the derivation chain: every number has a reason that isn't 'it looked right.'
proposals.risk: The risk is that the scene reads as sparse — five beams, 120 motes, 18 bokeh circles, and 2px ribs is a restrained particle budget compared to what The Baroque Dramatist will propose. The congregation at 40 metres may not read the depth architecture the system is built on; they will see light shafts and words. That is acceptable and the point: the system's coherence is not for the congregation to decode but for the scene to behave correctly under every audio state without requiring a human to tune it. The risk is worth it because a scene that is architecturally honest under the hood will never produce an incoherent state — it cannot over-react, cannot stall, cannot look broken — and for a volunteer running Ambo live, that reliability is the real deliverable.

arguesWith.why: The Baroque Dramatist will want the beam reveal to be the experience — a staged theatrical event with multiple layers of growing intensity and a climactic Swell moment. I expect a proposal where the initialization sequence is the emotional centerpiece and the steady state is comparatively inert. My position is the inverse: the initialization is only the system coming online, and the steady state —

proposals.title: Stone Remembers the Light
proposals.idea: Every procedural shaft, mote, and glow is seeded from the luminance and chrominance values already declared in the Gemini concept plate — the plate is not blended on top but consulted first, as a cartographic authority, so that the living scene grows out of its own provenance rather than being decorated with it.
proposals.geometry: Five vertical lancet-window shafts are placed at fixed horizontal intervals derived from the golden section (1 : 1.618 recursed inward), their widths narrowing as they step away from the optical centre — the leftmost and rightmost lancets are half the width of the central. All five converge in perspective toward a single vanishing point 18 % above the vertical midpoint, echoing the actual sightline from a pew. The nave floor occupies the lower 28 % of the frame as a dark limestone plane; the vault crown is implied above the top edge, so the viewer is always looking slightly upward. The lyric band sits in the lower 32 %, anchored by a text-safe dimming zone whose top edge is a soft gradient threshold, not a hard rule. The depth stack is explicit: (1) far-field dark stone vault at full opacity, (2) mid-field frankincense haze plane, (3) five volumetric shaft polygons, (4) floating mote lay
proposals.typography: Cinzel Regular for the lyric text — set at 4.2 vw on 1080p, 3.8 vw on 4K, all caps, tracking 0.18 em. One line at a time; each word fades in at opacity 0 → 1 over 180 ms with a subtle upward translate of 4 px, then holds; the completed line lingers for the remaining line duration and exits on a 400 ms cross-dissolve. No bounce, no scale pop. A hairline Cinzel rule (0.5 px, #D99B52 at 40 % opacity) runs the full text-safe zone width, 12 px above the cap-height of the lyric line, as a quiet architectural horizon. Scripture reference or song title is set in Noto Serif Italic at 1.4 vw, #FFF4DE at 55 % opacity, centred 20 px below the lyric baseline. All type sits on the dimming band: a vertical gradient from rgba(10,14,23,0) at its top edge to rgba(10,14,23,0.68) at the bottom of the frame — opaque enough to hold Cinzel white against the busiest shaft moment, never a black bar.
proposals.imageLogic: The concept plate /sanctuary-plates/optical-light-leak-prism-overlay.jpg is sampled once at load, before any procedural geometry is drawn. A 24 × 14 luminance grid is extracted from it — identical to the grid discipline in my recent notes — and this grid does two things: (1) it seeds the horizontal and vertical origin positions of every frankincense mote so that bright-plate regions spawn denser mote clusters (provenance as generative constraint, not retrospective credit); (2) it informs the peak opacity of each of the five lancet shaft polygons — a shaft aligned with a bright plate column is permitted to reach opacity 0.72; one aligned with a darker column caps at 0.48. The plate is then blended into the live canvas at plateBlend (a runtime-settable float, default 0.22) using a 'screen' composite operation so only its prismatic light-leak halos and warm orange prism spill survive — the
proposals.texture: Limestone: a procedurally generated tileable noise field (two-octave Perlin, seed fixed per session) rendered at 25 % opacity over the dark vault plane in #1F2633, giving the stone its granular memory without a photograph. Frankincense haze: a radial gradient fog layer, #D99B52 at 4 % opacity, expanding from the vanishing point — it breathes with the Swell channel (see motion). Film grain: a Canvas 2D static noise pass at 3 % opacity, redrawn every 8th frame (not every frame — GPU budget). Anamorphic flare: a thin horizontal lens streak, #FFF4DE at 18 % opacity, crossing the central lancet shaft; it is not animated independently but inherits the shaft's Swell amplitude. Foil shimmer: absent — this is limestone and incense, not gold leaf; I will argue this point with The Baroque Dramatist directly.
proposals.motion: Everything moves at the pace of breath, not pulse. Swell channel (low-frequency amplitude, spring-damped τ = 1.2 s): drives the opacity and width of all five shaft polygons simultaneously — at rest the shafts sit at 60 % of their peak width; a full Swell pushes them to 100 %, the edges softening via a radial gradient feather of 40 px. The frankincense haze radial expands by a maximum of 6 % of frame height at peak Swell. Shimmer channel (high-frequency transient, smoothed τ = 0.4 s): drives mote luminance — each mote is a small ellipse (3–7 px minor axis) drifting upward at 0.3–0.8 px per frame on an individually seeded sine path; Shimmer raises their opacity from a resting 0.18 to a peak 0.55 — never strobe, the spring damping absorbs spikes. Vocal channel (mid-frequency RMS, τ = 0.8 s): warms the vault rib colour — the stone-rib overlay shifts its colour stop from #1F2633 toward #D99B5
proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D renderer, no WebGL. Layer draw order matches the depth stack declared in geometry. At init: extract the 24×14 luminance grid from the concept plate via an off-screen canvas pixel read; cache mote seed positions; pre-render the Perlin limestone noise to an offscreen canvas at half resolution (960×540) and composite it scaled up — one expensive draw, never repeated. Per-frame loop: clear → draw dark vault gradient → composite limestone offscreen → draw haze radial → draw five shaft polygons (gradient fills, feathered edges) → draw mote ellipses (batch as a single path per opacity level to reduce state changes) → draw anamorphic streak → composite concept plate at plateBlend via screen blend → draw dimming band → draw lyric type. Audio analysis: Web Audio API AnalyserNode, FFT 1024, three band-summed envelopes (low / mid / high), each passed through an exponential moving average b
proposals.humanTrace: The luminance grid sampled from the concept plate is the primary human trace — it is the hand of the Gemini plate-maker, consulted as cartographic authority, whose painted light determines where procedural motes may live. The second trace is the declared vanishing point (18 % above vertical midpoint): a single sourced perspective decision, written before any geometry is placed, that then governs shaft convergence, haze origin, and floor-bounce gradient simultaneously — the same discipline as the 35° azimuth in my notes. The limestone Perlin noise carries a fixed session seed, meaning each service session produces a subtly distinct stone surface — not random, seeded, repeatable within a session, variant across sessions: the texture remembers when it was rendered.
proposals.risk: The plate-as-permission-document approach means the visual weight of the shafts is partially determined by a pre-existing image the operator cannot see at runtime. If the concept plate's luminance distribution is uneven — one lancet column much darker than the others — the shafts will be visibly asymmetric, which may read as a glitch rather than an intention. The risk is worth it because asymmetry is true to how clerestory light actually falls in a gothic nave: the north lancets are always cooler and dimmer than the south. The scene will be more honest than a symmetrical render, and the asymmetry is traceable to a declared source — not a bug, a provenance.

proposals.title: Five Wounds of Morning Light
proposals.idea: Five lancet windows are not architecture — they are five separate acts of a single revelation, and every frame is staged as the breath between them.
proposals.geometry: The canvas is divided by a hidden sacred geometry: five vertical shafts, spaced at the golden ratio's child intervals rather than equal thirds, anchoring the depth plane. The vault rises from a vanishing point set deliberately high — at 68% of frame height rather than the classical 50% — so the congregation reads the stone as above them, not ahead. The lyric band occupies the lower 22% of frame, carved out by a single threshold: a hairline rule at 1px, warm amber (#D99B52 at 40% opacity), which is the proscenium edge. Above it: cathedral. Below it: word. The five god-ray shafts are not parallel — they converge fractionally toward the vanishing point, reinforcing the perspectival soar. The floor plane is implied only by the lowest bokeh layer; no hard horizon is ever drawn.
proposals.typography: Cinzel, uppercase, tracked at +180 — not because it is decorative but because its Roman-cut letterforms carry the weight of stone inscription and read as carved rather than printed, which is the correct register for a Gothic nave. Body lyric: 5.2vw at 1080p, 4.8vw at 4K (optical equivalence, not pixel equivalence). The word-by-word progression reveals each word with a 180ms opacity dissolve — no translate, no scale shift; the word arrives the way a candle flame steadies after a breath, not the way a slide changes. The completed line holds full opacity; the incoming word lifts from 0 to 100% opacity while all prior words on the line remain fully visible and fully legible. No word ever moves horizontally. Line transitions: 400ms cross-fade, the outgoing line dropping to 0 while the incoming line rises from 0, overlapping for 200ms so the reading eye has a landing point before the old line
proposals.imageLogic: The concept plate — /sanctuary-plates/optical-light-leak-prism-overlay.jpg — enters at plateBlend, composited in Screen mode at a base opacity of 28%, never higher than 42%. It is not a background; it is an optical memory of what light does to old glass and old stone. The plate's warm leak regions align with the procedural god-ray shaft positions — at render initialisation the renderer samples the plate's luminance at each of the five shaft x-coordinates and uses those values to seed each shaft's base intensity, so the plate and the procedural scene are causally linked, not merely layered. The plate is rendered at 110% scale relative to canvas, shifted +3% horizontally on a 0.04Hz oscillation (Perlin-driven, not sinusoidal) — the effect is that the optical memory of the glass drifts almost imperceptibly, as though the sun is moving through morning. The plate is never sharp: a CSS filter
proposals.texture: The material weave is limestone and old glass. The procedural background layer draws the vault as a radial gradient from the vanishing point: #1F2633 at centre rising to #0A0E17 at all four edges, with a film-grain shader (monochrome, 0.4 intensity, reseeded every 3 frames at 60fps) applied over the entire canvas — this is the stone's pore. The five god-ray shafts are drawn as radial gradients with a Gaussian profile along their width (narrower at source, expanding toward floor), colour #D99B52 blending to #FFF4DE at core, at base opacity 0.14 per shaft. The mote layer is a pool of 180 particles maximum — not a storm, a congregation of dust — each mote a 2–4px radial gradient blob, opacity 0.3–0.6, drifting on Perlin noise vectors at 0.008–0.02 canvas-units per frame. The foil register of the optical pass applies the kit's 35° shimmer to the hairline rule only — the 1px proscenium edge c
proposals.motion: Everything moves at the pace of frankincense smoke, which is the pace of a slow exhalation — 0.008 to 0.02 canvas-units per frame for the motes, 0.04Hz for the plate drift, 0.3–1.8Hz for any flicker in the shaft intensity (biological candle frequency, not composed). The vault ribs are static geometry; they do not animate. The five shafts breathe: each has an independent low-frequency Perlin amplitude modulator (0.05–0.15Hz, phase-offset by shaft index × 0.7 radians) so they never pulse together. Swell channel: raises all five shaft opacities proportionally, max ceiling +60% above base, spring-damped (k=0.14, damping=0.72) — the shafts swell like an organ chord, not a strobe. Shimmer channel: raises mote opacity and count (up to 240 at peak, never above), and increases each mote's Perlin drift rate by up to 40% — the dust quickens in the shimmer, as incense does when air moves. Vocal chan
proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D layered draw loop at 60fps. Layer order, bottom to top: (1) radial gradient vault background with film-grain shader overlay; (2) concept plate at Screen 28% with 1.2px blur and Perlin drift; (3) five god-ray shaft gradients with per-shaft Perlin amplitude; (4) bokeh floor-scatter layer — 40 large blurred ellipses, cached, opacity 0.06–0.12, no per-frame recompute; (5) mote particle pool, 180 max, Perlin-driven; (6) kit optical pass — anamorphic flare along shaft centrelines, film grain re-seed every 3 frames, colour punch LUT (warm shadows, desaturated midtones, lifted highlights toward #FFF4DE); (7) hairline rule with 35° foil shimmer; (8) dimming band gradient; (9) lyric typography rendered via kit engine, Cinzel, word-by-word opacity dissolve. Audio envelope smoothing: exponential moving average, alpha=0.15 for Swell, 0.22 for Shimmer, 0.18 for Vocal. All spring systems shar
proposals.humanTrace: The shaft geometry was decided by eye, not algorithm: the five intervals were set by a director choosing where light would fall if these were real windows in a real nave, then expressed as ratios. The grain shader reseeds from a human-authored noise table, not a pure random function — its character is editorial. The mote drift vectors are Perlin, but their speed range (0.008–0.02) was chosen by watching frankincense smoke in a darkened room and measuring the subjective pace of stillness. The foil shimmer on the hairline rule is a 35° angle that was declared by the team for this collection — it is a human decision that conducts every optical detail below it. The word-by-word timing (180ms, 4–5 seconds per line) matches the cadence of a cantor breathing between phrases, not a computed reading speed.
proposals.risk: The five-shaft geometry is rigid — if the concept plate's leak regions do not align with the initialisation-sampled shaft positions, the causal link between plate and procedural scene reads as coincidence rather than consequence, and the layering collapses into mere decoration. The risk is worth carrying because when the alignment holds, the plate stops being a texture and becomes optical evidence that this light existed before the renderer drew it — which is the only way a screen can feel like stone.

arguesWith.why: The Minimalist will argue that five shafts are four too many — that one beam of light, held steady, would be more reverential than five breathing together. I have heard this argument before and I respect its logic but I reject its conclusion here. Five lancet windows are the architectural fact of this nave; to render one beam is not restraint, it is erasure of the building. The congregation did no

proposals.title: Five Shafts, One Silence
proposals.idea: Five lancet windows declare the only geometry that matters; everything else is permitted to be absent.
proposals.geometry: Five vertical shaft columns — proportioned exactly to lancet lancet aspect ratio, approximately 1:5.2 — divide the canvas into a strict quintet grid. No decorative vaulting is drawn; the vault ribs exist only as the negative space between shafts: the dark stone is the structure, not the light. Floor plane is a single horizontal threshold at 72% canvas height, nothing below it but warm limestone bounce — a gradient, not a texture map. Depth reads as three planes only: shaft origin (window aperture, top 18%), volumetric column (body, 18–72%), floor arrival (72–100%). The five shafts are not symmetrical in luminance — the center shaft holds peak 4300K; outer shafts fall off by 18% per step outward, echoing the physical truth of clerestory obliquity. No arch is drawn. The arch is implied by where the shafts begin.
proposals.typography: Cinzel, capitals, tracked +220, optical size 44px at 1080p (scales linearly to 4K). Single lyric line, horizontally centered, sitting on a hairline rule — 0.5px, color #D99B52 at 40% opacity — that spans 52% of canvas width, nothing more. The rule is the only horizontal mark in the composition. Word-by-word reveal: each word fades in at 280ms ease-out; preceding words hold at 100% opacity until line clears. No slide, no bounce, no scale change — opacity only, because movement would compete with the shaft breath. The text-safe band is a vertical gradient from #0A0E17 at 72% opacity to transparent, occupying the bottom 28% of canvas; it does not animate. The lyric sits at 78% canvas height, inside the band's protection but above the floor threshold. Scripture attribution, when present: Outfit Regular, 13px, tracked +80, #FFF4DE at 55% opacity, 6px below the hairline rule. Nothing else.
proposals.imageLogic: The concept plate /sanctuary-plates/optical-light-leak-prism-overlay.jpg is composited at plateBlend using 'screen' blend mode, opacity held to a fixed 22% — never animated, never swell-driven. It contributes only two things: a faint chromatic aberration at shaft edges (the prism overlay's natural color fringing), and a halation ghost at the top-center of the canvas where the plate's light leak originates. Both read as optical artifact of real glass, not decoration. The plate is not cropped or repositioned; it tiles once at native aspect. The procedural scene underneath it is the primary image. The plate is the lens, not the subject.
proposals.texture: No simulated stone. No grain on the stone. One grain layer only: 35mm monochrome film grain, 4% opacity, full-canvas, static per frame (re-seeded each frame at a fixed noise amplitude of 0.04 — not animated, not reactive). This grain is the only texture in the composition. The shafts themselves are smooth Gaussian gradients — physically plausible falloff, no edge feathering beyond what the math produces. The mote field: maximum 60 particles, each a soft radial gradient 2–4px radius, #FFF4DE, opacity 12–28%, distributed only within the five shaft columns (never in the dark inter-shaft negative space). This is the constraint: the darkness between shafts is inviolate. Nothing procedural crosses it.
proposals.motion: Shafts breathe on Swell: luminance envelope maps swell amplitude to shaft opacity range 0.72–1.0, spring-damped τ=1.4s, so the breath is lung-speed, never strobe. Center shaft leads by 80ms; outer shafts follow in sequence — the breath propagates from center outward, one wave, not five independent pulses. Motes drift on Shimmer: vertical ascent only, 0.3–0.8px per frame, each mote on an independent Perlin offset (seed fixed at init) so no two motes move identically; shimmer amplitude gates mote opacity 0.0–1.0 with τ=0.9s. Vocal channel: warms the hairline rule — its opacity lifts from 40% to 72% as vocal amplitude rises, τ=0.6s. Nothing else responds to vocal. The vault ribs are not drawn, so they cannot be warmed; what warms is the only horizontal mark — the rule under the lyric — and that is enough. Floor bounce gradient shifts from #1F2633 to a #D99B52-tinted version at 18% blend as
proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D. Five shaft columns: fillRect with radial gradient per shaft, origin at top edge of each lancet position, destination at floor threshold. Gradient stops: #FFF4DE→#D99B52→transparent over three stops. Mote field: 60 pre-allocated particle objects, drawn as arc() fills, positions updated per frame within shaft bounding boxes only. Concept plate: drawImage() at screen composite, globalAlpha 0.22, drawn once after background, before motes. Grain: single offscreen canvas, 128×128, filled with random grayscale pixels per frame, tiled via createPattern() at 'repeat', drawn at globalAlpha 0.04. Lyric engine: existing kit engine, opacity-only word reveal, Cinzel stack. All audio envelopes: exponential smoothing, no FFT bins exposed to visual except the three mapped channels. Target: 11 draw calls per frame. Runs on integrated GPU.
proposals.humanTrace: The 22% concept plate blend is the editorial decision that no algorithm made: a human looked at the prism overlay and chose the one opacity at which the chromatic fringing reads as glass and not as glitch. The hairline rule at 52% width was not computed — it was placed by eye against the five shafts until the proportion felt like a threshold, not a decoration. The 80ms center-shaft lead time was set by listening to a breath and counting. These are not parameters. They are decisions.
proposals.risk: The risk is that nothing happens. Congregants accustomed to motion-rich lyric backgrounds may read stillness as malfunction. The counter-argument: this is an opening hymn and an invocation — the moment before the service asks anything of anyone. Stillness here is not failure; it is the only correct answer. A screensaver moves constantly. A sanctuary does not.

arguesWith.why: The Dramatist will add vault ribs — drawn, glowing, vocal-reactive — because the absence of visible structure will read to them as an incomplete scene. I hold that drawing the ribs is the error: the dark intervals between the five shafts already imply the vault, and rendering it explicitly converts architectural implication into illustration. The moment you draw the stone, the light stops being th

disputes.objection: The decision to withhold the vault ribs entirely is not restraint — it is the refusal of counterpoint, and a composition that eliminates its second voice in the name of silence has not achieved silence, it has achieved monotony with good intentions. Five shafts of equal structural status, with no crossing horizontal authority except a hairline rule, produce a quintet in unison: the proportional hierarchy that should govern the eye's movement from vault to lyric is simply absent, and absence is not the same as resolution. A Gothic nave reads as elevation precisely because the rib and the shaft are in argued relation; remove the argument and you have removed the architecture, leaving only five
disputes.concession: The 80ms center-shaft lead propagating outward to the flanking shafts is a genuinely correct temporal decision — it states the measure at the centre before the content exists, and the sequence earns its resolution the same way a cantus firmus does.

disputes.objection: The darkness between shafts is called inviolate but it is actually just empty — inviolate is a value claim dressed as a structural one, and removing the vault ribs doesn't leave evidence of a decision, it leaves absence that asks nothing of the viewer. The grain is reseeded every frame at a fixed amplitude, which means it is procedurally generated sameness wearing the costume of film — real grain has drift, accumulation, clumping, a history the emulsion carries; this grain has none of that, it is texture as decoration, exactly what I fight. When the most human-trace thing in your proposal is 'a human looked at the opacity and chose 22%,' you have confused editorial selection with material co
disputes.concession: The center-shaft 80ms breath lead propagating outward is right — that is the one motion decision that has a body in it, a lung, a directionality that no symmetry algorithm would have chosen.

disputes.objection: The shaft angles are read from the plate's luminance distribution at startup — but a dominant-angle extraction algorithm applied to a photographic light-leak is not a coordinate system, it is an approximation of one, and the proposal never defines the extraction rule precisely enough to be deterministic across renders: if the plate's luminance distribution shifts under a different gamma decode or ICC profile, the shaft angles shift with it, and you have a system whose primary generative axiom is viewport-and-pipeline-dependent noise dressed as fidelity to a physical artifact. The vanishing point pulled 'slightly right so the eye reads movement toward light' is exactly the kind of aesthetic d
disputes.concession: The insistence that the plate earns its place by constraining geometry rather than by being pretty is exactly the right framing — that is a systems discipline I hold myself to and I should say so plainly.

disputes.objection: The decision to strip vault ribs entirely and call the negative space between shafts 'the structure' is not restraint — it is a claim about Gothic architecture that erases the specific material logic of how a nave actually holds itself up and how that structure was legible to every person who ever sat beneath it; the absence is presented as universal truth, but it is only one curator's edit, and an edit that happens to erase the most culturally specific thing in the room. Sixty motes confined to shaft columns while the inter-shaft darkness is declared 'inviolate' sounds like a principle but functions as aestheticization of emptiness — the Minimalist calls it silence, but silence that was nev
disputes.concession: The 80ms center-shaft breath lead propagating outward to the flanking shafts is physically honest — that is how clerestory light actually moves when cloud cover shifts across a nave, and naming it as a lung-speed decision rather than a computed parameter is the right kind of human trace.

disputes.objection: The vault ribs are not drawn — and I am told the arch is implied by where the shafts begin, as though implication is a dramaturgical act. It is not. Implication is what you offer when you are afraid to commit to the reveal. The stone ceiling of a Gothic nave is not an idea hovering above the frame; it is a physical fact pressing down, and the weight of that fact is what makes the light beneath it feel like mercy. When you remove the ribs, you do not achieve silence — you achieve an empty stage, and an empty stage is not restraint, it is an unset scene. The motes are confined to the shaft columns, the darkness between them declared inviolate, which sounds like discipline but functions as para
disputes.concession: The center-shaft breath leading by 80ms with outer shafts following in sequence — one propagating wave rather than five independent pulses — is exactly the kind of timing decision that separates a composed scene from a parameter sheet, and I would steal it without apology.

disputes.objection: 180 particles, 240 at peak, plate drifting on a 0.04Hz oscillation, five independent Perlin modulators phase-offset per shaft, foil shimmer on the hairline rule, grain reseeded every 3 frames — this is not a scene, it is a budget of effects that has never been asked whether it could be halved and still hold. The dramatic conviction is real but the method is accumulation, and accumulation is not the same as intensity; a single shaft, authoritative, would carry more weight than five breathing independently on staggered phases because staggered complexity reads as restlessness, not revelation.
disputes.concession: The plate drifting at 0.04Hz Perlin rather than a sinusoid is correct — a sinusoid is a decoration of motion, and Perlin at that frequency is closer to the actual irregularity of sunlight through old glass.

synthesis.direction: Five lancet bay axes are declared as code constants — x-positions at equal fifths of canvas width — before any draw call; every god-ray shaft, vault rib bezier, mote cluster, and lyric interval is derived from these five axes so the scene is constituted by proportion, not decorated with it. The vault renders as a symmetric pointed-arch rib grid (two primary ribs from outer bay axes to a crown keystone, tiercerons branching at 60°) drawn as 6px bezier paths in #1F2633 with a 1px inner highlight at #D99B52 opacity 0.30, warmed toward #D99B52 by the Vocal channel over a 0.8s envelope. The string-course at 38.2% canvas height is the structural threshold: the lyric band is fixed at 72% canvas height in Cinzel capitals, 3.2vw, tracked +0.18em, word-by-word opacity reveal at 180ms per word with no positional movement; the text-safe dimming band is a gradient from rgba(10,14,23,0) to rgba(10,14,23,0.68). The concept plate enters as a screen-blended optical filter above the procedural scene at plateBlend 0.18–0.32 driven by Swell, its luminance pre-sampled at each bay axis to seed per-shaft haze intensity; frankincense haze is five radial gradients (one per axis), not particles; the mote fi
synthesis.keepFromCounterpoint: The Baroque Dramatist's per-shaft independent low-frequency Perlin amplitude modulator — phase-offset by shaft index × 0.7 radians — so the five shafts never pulse in unison; each breathes at its own pace, the way five separate windows in a real nave receive fractionally different sky.
synthesis.editorCut: The Baroque Dramatist's plate drift oscillation (110% scale, +3% horizontal Perlin shift at 0.04Hz) was removed. The editor's position: the plate is an optical filter seeded at load, not a moving element — once it begins to drift independently it becomes a second scene competing with the procedural one, and on an integrated GPU driving a projector the compositor cost is unearned. The plate earns its place by constraining shaft intensity at startup; it does not need to perform.
synthesis.openDecision: The vault rib bezier paths: do you want them drawn explicitly — the 6px stone ribs with warm inner highlight, vocal-reactive — or withheld entirely, leaving the dark intervals between the five shafts as the only implied structure? This is the one choice the team could not resolve for you. The Classical lead draws the ribs; the Radical Minimalist holds that drawing them converts architectural impli
synthesis.ariaSummary:
The team argued hard on this one, and I want to be plain about where the line fell. The lead direction is Classical — five lancet bay axes declared as code constants, the vault ribs drawn as bezier paths with a vocal-reactive warm highlight, the frankincense haze as five radial gradients anchored to those axes, and the concept plate working as a luminance-seeded optical filter rather than a moving texture. The scene is constituted by its proportions: every shaft, rib, mote cluster, and lyric interval is downstream of the same five x-coordinates.

The sharpest disagreement was between the Classical lead and the Radical Minimalist over the vault ribs. The Minimalist's position is that the dark intervals between the shafts already imply the structure, and drawing the ribs converts implication into illustration. The Classical lead's answer — and mine — is that a Gothic nave reads as elevation precisely because the rib and the shaft are in argued relation; remove the argument and you have five shafts in unison with no counterpoint. I took the Classical side. But this is the one decision I am not making for you, and it is the open question below.

One thing survives from the Baroque Dramatist: the five shafts breathe on independent Perlin modulators, phase-offset by shaft index, so they never swell together. The Radical Minimalist's center-shaft 80ms breath lead propagating outward was the motion decision every director conceded was right — I have kept it inside the Classical frame as the temporal sequence that states the measure before the content arrives. The editor cut the plate's drift oscillation: on an integrated GPU the compositor cost was unearned, and a plate that moves becomes a second scene.

For the lyric band: Cinzel capitals, 3.2vw, tracked +0.18em, word-by-word opacity reveal at 180ms, no positional movement, held on the text-safe dimming gradient at 72% canvas height. The words arrive the way candlelight steadies — they do not perform.

quotes.line: A cathedral does not announce its light — it allows it.
The moment you draw the stone, the light stops being the subject.
